future_physics_backlog.description: Replace event-only separation with independently propagated attached-stack and released-glider histories.
future_physics_backlog.dependency: A participating dual-launch plant, accepted separation-state transfer, and post-separation execution evidence.

future_physics_backlog.description: Execute the source DAVE-ML rigid-body plants through complete missions instead of local or reduced witnesses.
future_physics_backlog.dependency: Source-bounded initialization, controller, phase, and terminal-condition adapters.

future_physics_backlog.description: Complete the end-to-end high-energy X-15 release, burn/coast, atmospheric handoff, and terminal mission.
future_physics_backlog.dependency: Phase-scheduled direct-wrench control and source-bounded high-energy terminal objectives.

future_physics_backlog.description: Complete the source-plant HL-20 high-energy glide and terminal mission.
future_physics_backlog.dependency: Validated glide guidance, surface allocation, and source-bounded terminal objectives.

future_physics_backlog.description: Promote applicable rigid-body missions from direct wrench or reduced guidance to aerodynamic-surface, mixed, or thrust-vector allocation.
future_physics_backlog.dependency: Source-backed effectiveness maps, signs, limits, rates, and schedule-wide authority evidence.

future_physics_backlog.description: Bind individual-rotor allocation and rigid-body dynamics to the complete hover/yaw mission.
future_physics_backlog.dependency: Source-backed rotor/motor effectiveness and accepted mission-level authority evidence.

future_physics_backlog.description: Replace source-history replay with a participating staged rocket and gimbal/thrust-vector allocation.
future_physics_backlog.dependency: Source-backed propulsion, mass, guidance, gimbal, and stage-transition dynamics.

future_physics_backlog.description: Propagate separated NESC stages as first-class child trajectories rather than event-only lineage.
future_physics_backlog.dependency: Detached-stage mass, aerodynamic, attitude, and separation-state definitions.

future_physics_backlog.description: Promote named passive geometries from point-mass/pseudo-6-DOF witnesses to a qualified rigid-body 6-DOF contract.
